changelog:
Initial release of the arena-research skill — a general-purpose research agent for Are.na:

- Enables curated search across Are.na for channels, blocks, users, and connections.
- Explores the connection graph to surface adjacent ideas and influential curators.
- Provides CLI scripts for searching, exploring channels/blocks, traversing connections, and listing user info.
- Includes guide for agentic research: decomposing questions, identifying key collections, and following conceptual links.
- Clarifies best use cases vs. other research sources (e.g., X/Twitter, web search).
- Not intended for posting content or account management.
summary: Search and explore Are.na for curated channels, references, and visual inspiration by analyzing connections and identifying key curators across any topic.
